title: Kodiak 100K — HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB 2026
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The 100K is 101.1 KM with 3,143 m of gain, starts at The Village of Big Bear Lake on Saturday 10 October 2026 at 06:00 and has a 20-hour-15-minute limit; it carries 6 Running Stones.
The course uses Big Bear's South Shore trails including Sugarloaf Mountain (9,995 ft) and Skyline Trail.
The page says the 2026 routes are final and offers a final 2026 GPX file.
